result: Critics and fact-checkers who dismiss this topic as fiction are, in the author's view, careless and uninformed. Komisaruk and Whipple showed that cervical stimulation can produce orgasm even in women with a severed spinal cord, because the vagus nerve can carry the signal without using the spinal route that clitoral orgasms use. This laboratory evidence establishes that the phenomenon is unique. Kim Anami, Diana Richardson, and other popular educators and promoters of cervical orgasms go further, claiming that these orgasms can provide days of afterglow, as well as spiritual and physical healings.
